description: BunnyShell (Environment-as-a-Service) lifecycle. action=CONFIG returns project settings (secrets never returned). action=PROVISION creates an environment (wait defaults true and polls until deployed + component URLs; set wait=false for create/deploy trigger only). action=STATUS polls bnsEnvironmentId. Use destroy-ephemeral-environment to delete. Progress is logged to stderr (CLI) or MCP logging when waiting.
name: ephemeral-environment
title: Ephemeral Environment
